Fit a classification model for boundary logic analysis

bl_fit_model.Rd

Fits one of the supported ML classifiers on binary 0/1 training data and returns the fitted model together with training accuracy and Gini coefficient.

Usage

bl_fit_model(
  train_data,
  var_names,
  model_type = "GLM",
  cutoff = 0.5,
  model_params = list()
)

Arguments

train_data

Data frame with feature columns named by var_names plus a column named "class" (numeric 0/1).

var_names

Character vector of feature column names.

model_type

Character scalar specifying the model family. One of: "GLM" (logistic regression), "SVM" (support vector machine), "NNET" (neural network), "RForest" (rpart decision tree). Default "GLM". For other model families (XGBoost, GBM, GAM, LDA) use bl_wrap_model() with the externally fitted object.

cutoff

Numeric decision threshold for computing accuracy. Default 0.5.

model_params

Named list of hyperparameter overrides. Unrecognised keys trigger a warning. Parameter names follow parsnip conventions. Common overrides:

  • NNET: list(hidden_units = 10, penalty = 0.01, epochs = 500)

  • RForest: list(min_n = 10)

Value

A list of class "bl_model" with components:

model

The fitted model object.

model_type

Character; the model family used.

var_names

Character vector of feature names.

cutoff

The decision threshold.

accuracy

Numeric; classification accuracy on train_data.

gini

Numeric; Gini coefficient on train_data.

Examples

bl_dat <- bl_prepare_data(datasets::iris,
                           class_col    = "Species",
                           target_class = "versicolor")
#> Hull fraction: 0.90 | Retained: 110 (91.7%) | Removed: 10 (8.3%)
bl_mod <- bl_fit_model(bl_dat$train_data, bl_dat$var_names,
                       model_type = "GLM")
print(bl_mod)
